s: According to the Forbes World's Billionaires list 2026, who is the richest Indian woman?
x: In the Forbes 2026 list, Savitri Jindal is the richest Indian woman; Mukesh Ambani is the richest Indian, then Gautam Adani.

s: Which country has the most billionaires in the Forbes World's Billionaires list 2026?
x: The USA has the most billionaires (989) of the 3,428 in the Forbes 2026 list; India (229) is third after the USA and China.

s: Which Indian actor was given an honorary OBE in 2004?
x: Om Puri was made an honorary Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in 2004.

s: Which Indian chef was named in the TIME 100 list of April 2026?
x: TIME 100 (2026) named Sundar Pichai, chef Vikas Khanna and actor Ranbir Kapoor.

s: Which founder of Paytm was named in the TIME 100 list of 2017?
x: Vijay Shekhar Sharma (Paytm) and PM Modi were the Indians on TIME 100 in 2017.

s: Who received an honorary degree from Harvard University in 2017?
x: Mark Zuckerberg got an honorary Harvard degree in 2017; Bill Gates got one in 2007.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Forbes billionaires lists:
1. Jeff Bezos was the world's richest person in the Forbes list of 2019.
2. India had the most billionaires in the Forbes list of 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Bezos topped Forbes 2019; in 2026 the USA had the most billionaires (989) and India was 3rd (229).

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. TIME 100 is published by TIME magazine.
2. TIME Person of the Year is published by TIME magazine.
3. The Forbes billionaires list is published by TIME magazine.
Which of the above statements are correct?
x: TIME publishes TIME 100 and Person of the Year; the Forbes billionaires list is published by Forbes, not TIME.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India was elected unopposed to the UN Human Rights Council for 2026-2028, its 7th term.
2. About 100 APNRTS Goodwill Ambassadors have been posted in the six Gulf countries to help migrants from Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both statements are correct. India won its 7th UNHRC term (2026-28) unopposed, and about 100 APNRTS Goodwill Ambassadors were posted in the six Gulf countries in 2026. The other options each reject a true statement.

s: Who chooses the UN Messengers of Peace?
x: UN Messengers of Peace are chosen by the UN Secretary-General.

s: Who is the youngest-ever UN Messenger of Peace, designated in 2017?
x: Malala Yousafzai, designated in 2017, is the youngest-ever UN Messenger of Peace.

s: What is the tenure of the Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners?
o: Five years or until the age of 62, whichever is earlier
Six years or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier
Five years or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier
Six years without an age limit
x: The CEC and Election Commissioners hold office for six years or until age 65, whichever is earlier. Five years and age 62 are traps, and there is an age limit.

s: The Chief Justice of India's temporary place on the CEC selection panel arose from which case (March 2023)?
x: The CJI's inclusion came from the Anoop Baranwal decision of March 2023, which the Supreme Court called temporary in May 2026.

s: At what age does the Chief Justice of India retire?
x: The CJI retires at 65, the same age limit as the CEC's tenure rule.

s: Who became the 26th Chief Election Commissioner of India in February 2025?
x: Gyanesh Kumar took charge as the 26th CEC on 19 February 2025, succeeding Rajiv Kumar.

s: Whom did Gyanesh Kumar succeed as Chief Election Commissioner on 19 February 2025?
x: Rajiv Kumar left office on 18 February 2025; Vivek Joshi joined as Election Commissioner the same day.
